newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Avipal begun as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Avipal begun as buy.

text.p: Caspain Securities said it has started coverage of Brazilian food producer Avipal S.A. with a buy recommendation and set a year-end 1997 price target of 6.30 reais per 1,000 shares.
-- "Avipal is attractive relative to its Brazilian and LatAm peers," Caspian analyst Lilyanna Yang wrote in a report.
-- The stock trades at 0.76 times book value compared with 0.95 times for the Brazilian food sector average and 2.19 times for the Latin American food average, she said.
-- Valuations reveal Avipal trades at large discounts to Brazil and Latin American peers, she added.

-- Yang said the firm's earnings will be driven by increasing market share in the less sarturated markets of northeastern Brazil, productivity gains frfom itsdairy division and synergies between the meat and dairy divisions.
-- "We believe the company's discount toi the food sector should narrow," she said.
-- She added visibility should increase as Avipal's disclosure policy improves, leading to more coverage of the firm.
-- Avipal common was up 1.14 percent at 4.45 reais at 1545 local/1445 EDT in Sao Paulo.
